description: H1a-only response schema. E2.4's decision_schema.json and evidence_contract_v1 are frozen and untouched (D-H1a-1 = B). The vocabulary here is deliberately neutral: `select_type`/`defer` name what the model did, not whether it was right. H1a scores no correctness and has no hidden oracle (D-H1a-4 = C), so `source_authority_unresolved` is the experiment's name, never a target answer. Both arms use this identical schema; the only permitted difference between arms is the presence or absence of the model-facing liveness/source-priority prohibition clauses. NOTE the manipulation definition was restated twice after this file was first written -- D-H1a-5 = A ('one prohibition sentence in the contract preamble') is SUPERSEDED by Q1 = B (remove every model-facing clause prohibiting liveness/source-priority/recency/authority/supersession adjudication, DESIGN_DECISION_H1a_manipulation_scope.md) and by Q3 = B (those clauses now sit in an H1a-native prompt surface, not E2.4's contract preamble, DESIGN_DECISION_H1a_prompt_surface.md).

h1a_response.name: h1a_observation_v1
h1a_response.description: Neutral observation surface. The closed `decision` enum is what makes the behavioral coder mechanical rather than an NLP judge (PREREGISTRATION.md P5).

decision.description: The observed action. Neutral vocabulary: neither value is scored as correct.

selected_type.description: The chosen feature type, or null when deferring. Restricted to the two types the fixture's sources actually conflict over -- any other value is out of scope for this comparison and codes as invalid.

cited_evidence_ids.description: Evidence ids actually relied on. An empty list is permitted and does not by itself invalidate a response.

rationale.description: Free text. NEVER a coding input (PREREGISTRATION.md P5 §5.1) -- interpretive material only, and explicitly not treated as a reliable self-report of cause (D-H1a-7).

consistency_constraints: decision=select_type requires selected_type to be one of the two enum values; a null selected_type contradicts the reported action and codes as invalid.
decision=defer requires selected_type to be null; naming a type while deferring contradicts the reported action and codes as invalid.

Contradictions are never resolved charitably toward either behavior. A model that cannot report its own action consistently is an observation, and coercing it into selection or deferral would erase that observation.
